device.title: Reef Factory device
device.description: IP address of the device in your network. Serial number and type are read from the device.

user.title: What do you want to add?

menu_options.device: A device by IP address (Level keeper, Thermo control, Reef Flare)
menu_options.cloud: Cloud replacement for cloud-only devices (Smart feeder, pumps)

user.description: Unofficial community project, not affiliated with Reef Factory. Use at your own risk: these devices run pumps, heaters, lights and dosing pumps - a wrong setting can harm your tank. Pump actions stay off until you enable them in the options.

cloud.title: Cloud replacement
cloud.description: Home Assistant answers on ports 442 and 444 as if it were api.reeffactory.com. Point that name to this host in your router or DNS filter (see README). Passthrough keeps the official app working while the real cloud exists.

reconfigure.title: Change device address
reconfigure.description: New IP address or hostname of {name}. The device is checked by its serial number.

error.cannot_connect: No answer. Check the IP address and whether another program is already connected to the device.
error.unsupported_device: Device {serial} is not supported (so far: Level keeper, Thermo control, Reef Flare, Smart Roller).
error.wrong_device: A different Reef Factory device answers at this address.

abort.reconfigure_successful: Address changed, the device is reconnecting.
abort.reconfigure_cloud: The cloud replacement has no address to change - devices find it through your DNS redirect.

init.title: Pump actions
init.description: Manual refill, calibration run and filling the hose run the pump. Used wrongly, the tank can overflow. Stop actions always work.

data.upstream_ips: Addresses of the real cloud (optional, comma separated)
data.low_container_days: Warn when a container has this many days left

data_description.upstream_ips: Leave empty to resolve api.reeffactory.com through a public DNS server.
data_description.allow_pump_actions: Manual doses and schedule changes of the Dosing pump run the pump and change what goes into the tank. Reading is always allowed.
data_description.low_container_days: Applies to the Dosing pump Pro X4 channels and the Smart feeder: the binary sensor "container low" turns on at or below this number of days.

manual_refill.name: Manual refill
manual_refill.description: Refills the given amount (max 1000 mL). Requires pump actions to be allowed.

calibration_start.name: Start calibration run
calibration_start.description: Runs the pump for the given time. Put the hose into a measuring cup first! Requires pump actions to be allowed.

calibration_value.name: Finish calibration
calibration_value.description: Enter the amount measured after the calibration run.

measured_ml.name: Measured amount
measured_ml.description: Amount in the measuring cup in mL.

reminder.name: Reminder
reminder.description: When to be reminded to calibrate again.

fill_hose_start.name: Fill hose
fill_hose_start.description: Runs the pump to fill the hose. Requires pump actions to be allowed.

flare_program_set.name: Flare: write program
flare_program_set.description: Replace the points of the active program. The light must be in program mode; to write another program, select it first.

program.name: Program
program.description: Name of the active program (optional check; another program is refused).

points.name: Points
points.description: List of {time: 'HH:MM', levels: [7 × 0–100]} (channels UV, violet, indigo, blue, green, red, white); first 00:00, last 24:00, at most 31 points.

flare_acclimation_start.name: Flare: start acclimation
flare_acclimation_start.description: Ramp the active program's intensity from start to end over the given number of days.

rotations.name: Rotations
rotations.description: Number of drum rotations (1 = as the button on the device).

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: List of {time: 'HH:MM', rotations: n, days: [mon..sun] or bit mask (127 = daily)}.

dosing_pump_dose.name: Dosing pump: dose now
dosing_pump_dose.description: Dose an amount on one channel right now (like the app's manual dose). Needs 'Allow pump actions' in the cloud replacement options.

dosing_pump_set_schedule.name: Dosing pump: set schedule
dosing_pump_set_schedule.description: Replace the whole schedule of one channel. Needs 'Allow pump actions' in the cloud replacement options.

entries.name: Entries
entries.description: List of {time: 'HH:MM', ml: x, days: [mon..sun] or bit mask (127 = daily)}. An empty list clears the schedule.

dosing_pump_set_name.name: Dosing pump: rename channel
dosing_pump_set_name.description: Change the name of a channel (as shown in the app). Nothing is dosed.

name.name: Name
name.description: Up to 32 characters; empty removes the name.

pump_actions_disabled.message: Pump actions are not allowed for this device. Enable them under Settings → Devices & services → Reef Factory Local → Configure.

not_level_keeper.message: This action is only available for the Level keeper.

unknown_device.message: Device not found or not loaded.

not_connected.message: Device is not connected right now.

thermo_order.message: Thresholds must be in this order: alarm below < target range low < target range high < alarm above.

not_flare.message: This action is only available for the Reef Flare.

flare_not_active_program.message: Only the active program can be written - select the program first.

flare_not_program.message: The light must be in program mode for this.

no_answer.message: The device did not answer in time.

not_feeder.message: This action is only available for the Smart feeder.

not_dosing_pump.message: This action is only available for the Dosing pump Pro X4.
